entries.title: III John 1:1
segments: ¶I, a ruler in the church, send word to the well loved Gaius, for whom I have true love.

entries.title: III John 1:2
segments: My loved one, it is my prayer that you may do well in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does well.

entries.title: III John 1:3
segments: ¶For it gave me great joy when some of the brothers came and gave witness that you had the true faith and were walking in the true way.

entries.title: III John 1:4
segments: I have no greater joy than to have news that my children are walking in the true way.

entries.title: III John 1:5
segments: My loved one, you are doing a good work in being kind to those brothers who come from other places;

entries.title: III John 1:6
segments: Who have given witness to the church of your love for them: and you will do well to send them on their way well cared for, as is right for servants of God:

entries.title: III John 1:7
segments: For they went out for love of the Name, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

entries.title: III John 1:8
segments: So it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that we may take our part in the work of the true faith.

entries.title: III John 1:9
segments: ¶I sent a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, whose desire is ever to have the first place among them, will not have us there.

entries.title: III John 1:10
segments: So if I come, I will keep in mind the things he does, talking against us with evil words: and as if this was not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those who are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.

entries.title: III John 1:11
segments: My loved one, do not be copying what is evil, but what is good. He who does good is of God: he who does evil has not seen God.

entries.title: III John 1:12
segments: ¶Demetrius has the approval of all men and of what is true: and we give the same witness, and you are certain that our witness is true.

entries.title: III John 1:13
segments: I had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all down with ink and pen:

entries.title: III John 1:14
segments: But I am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk with you face to face. May you have peace. Your friends here send you their love. Give my love to our friends by name.
